title: Discussion on Internship Opportunities and Academic Policies
summary_brief: The meeting focused on discussing internship opportunities for students, particularly regarding policies for internships in Singapore and abroad. Participants raised questions about course registration, leave of absence, and the requirements for self-sourced projects, with the advisor providing clarifications and guidance on these topics.

actions.description_plain: Provide a detailed explanation of the internship policies and requirements for students, especially regarding overseas internships and self-sourced projects.

actions.task: Prepare supporting letters for credit-bearing courses
actions.description_plain: Draft and send out letters certifying that courses 6222, 6223, and 6211 are credit-bearing to students.
